name: Your agent programs in a computer
what: Any agent program runs in a computer unmodified, including one Silo does not offer to install. Silo works with a program only through its documented surfaces, and disguises nothing. The programs Silo offers, and what it knows of each (such as where it keeps its login and its sessions, where it reads instructions and skills, how it takes a conversation up again), are data.

suggest.why: It is what lets you keep the agent programs you already use, and every other feature of agent programs stands on it.
